description: This file defines the InstallOnExistingDatabaseCommand class, which is part of a command-line installer utility for configuring an existing database for the OrangeHRM system. It handles user input for database connection details, checks database connection validity, and ensures the database is empty before proceeding.

classes.name: InstallOnExistingDatabaseCommand
classes.description: This class extends the InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand to facilitate configuration of an existing database by collecting connection information from the user, validating the connection, and checking if the database is empty before proceeding.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name string used to invoke this command ('install:on-existing-database').

methods.name: databaseInformation
methods.description: Gathers database connection details from the user via CLI prompts, validates connection, and ensures the database is empty. Stores the database info in state and handles errors by retrying input.
